title: Huly hero
description: Near-black hero with a huge white-to-lavender headline, a glowing ember pill, and a vertical blue-violet light beam that lands on a product window and flares along its top edge. A line of product areas sits underneath and scrolls as a marquee on phones.
notes: dark by default (tone="dark" adds the dark class); the beam reads best on a dark backdrop
the beam, flare and marquee are CSS animations, off under reduced motion; no JavaScript
leaves room at the top for a floating header (huly-header with position="absolute")
